# Transporeon: Open Visibility API (for third parties)

- **Product:** Transporeon: Open Visibility API (for third parties) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** Bearer token. Declared security schemes: bearerAuth.
- **Access:** Third parties receiving selected transport updates.
- **To call it you would need:** a Transporeon Visibility (Sixfold) bearer token.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.sixfold.com/v1`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/sixfold-v1-documentation-open-visibility-api-yaml](https://api.sixfold.com/v1/documentation/open-visibility/api.yaml) (Open Visibility API, version 1.3.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/467075089/Open+Visibility+Data+for+third+parties.

## open-visibility

| Method | Path | Disposition | Summary | Parameters |
